references.text: God's original instructions to Moses to make the ark of acacia wood with the exact measurements that Bezalel is now carrying out.
God appoints Bezalel by name and fills him with His Spirit to perform all the craftsmanship work on the tabernacle.
Moses presents Bezalel to the people as the one God has chosen and equipped to lead the work on the sanctuary.
The continuation of Bezalel's work on the ark, including the gold overlay and the cherubim on the mercy seat.
Moses describes the ark he made from acacia wood to store the tablets of the law.
The book of Hebrews describes the ark of the covenant and its contents as part of the sanctuary of the old covenant, which points forward to Christ.
This is a direct fulfillment reference where the instruction in chapter 25 is carried out in chapter 37.
